onboarding.languageBody: वह भाषा चुनें जिसका आप उपयोग करना चाहते हैं. आप इसे बाद में सेटिंग में बदल सकते हैं.

ads.label: Ad
ads.whyBody: Ads in public channels match the channel topic and language, never your messages, contacts or profile.
ads.whyPoint1: No message, contact or profile data is used.
ads.whyPoint2: No cross-site pixels or advertising IDs.
ads.whyPoint3: Channel owners and advertisers see aggregates only.
ads.whyContext: This placement was bought by {{advertiser}} through Nova Ads. It is not personalised from your private data.

moderation.title: Moderation & appeals
moderation.subtitle: Rules, reports and restrictions
moderation.reportSubtitle: Your report is queued on this device
moderation.detailsHint: Do not include passwords, keys or private chats.
moderation.blockAdvertiserHint: You will not see ads from them again on this device.
moderation.falseReportWarning: False or abusive reports can be rate-limited. Never report someone just to silence them.
moderation.receivedBody: Thank you. Your report is in the moderation queue.
moderation.receivedReview: Review and server sync are not connected in this build; the case stays on this device for now.
moderation.advertiserBlocked: This advertiser is now blocked on this device.
moderation.localOnly: This build stores moderation actions locally. Server sync and moderator responses are not connected yet; this is a UI and data-flow prototype.
moderation.relayPausedBody: Sending through the relay is blocked for this identity until the sanction ends.
moderation.keysStayBody: Your recovery phrase and local history remain on your device.
moderation.noSecretBody: Moderators see the report and case data, never your encrypted chats.
moderation.appealHint: One appeal per sanction. Explain what was wrong and include context.
moderation.appealTooShort: Add a little more detail (at least 20 characters).
moderation.appealClosed: This sanction can no longer be appealed.
moderation.appealAlready: An appeal is already on file.
moderation.appealResponseHint: A reviewer will respond in the app. Do not send keys or personal documents.
moderation.clearBody: Your identity is in good standing. Reports are reviewed by humans; automatic actions are limited to clear, high-confidence cases.
moderation.rulesBody: Strict rules cover illegal goods, substances, violence, CSAM, privacy, spam and impersonation.
moderation.howStep1: A report is queued with the target, reason and optional note.
moderation.howStep2: A moderator reviews it; urgent cases are prioritised.
moderation.howStep3: You can appeal a sanction once, in the app, without email.
moderation.noIdentityNote: Nova never asks for a phone, email or ID for moderation. Sanctions apply to a pseudonymous key, not a legal identity.
moderation.footer: End-to-end encrypted chats are never scanned.
